'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Israel–Hamas war hostage crisis]]
***[[2023 Israel–Hamas ceasefire]]
****The [[Cabinet of Israel]] approves a deal to [[ceasefire|pause fighting]] in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] for four days. The deal, negotiated by [[Egypt]], [[Qatar]], and the [[United States]], will also see [[Israel]] release 150 [[Palestinian prisoners]] [[prisoner exchange|in exchange]] for the release of some of the [[2023 Israel–Hamas war hostage crisis|hostages held by Hamas]], mostly women and children. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/cabinet-approves-deal-for-return-of-50-hostages-in-exchange-for-multi-day-ceasefire/ (''The Times of Israel'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Sam Altman]] returns as [[CEO]] of American [[artificial intelligence]] company [[OpenAI]], only days after being [[dismissal (employment)|dismissed]] by the company's Board of Directors on November 17. The surprise dismissal had resulted in major pushback, with 95% of company workers saying that they would quit if Altman was not brought back as CEO. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-67494165 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Rainbow Bridge explosion]]
**A car [[explode]]s near the [[Canada–United States border]] at the [[Rainbow Bridge (Niagara Falls)|Rainbow Bridge]] in [[Niagara Falls, New York|Niagara Falls]], [[New York (state)|New York]], [[United States]], killing the two people inside the vehicle and injuring a [[United States Border Patrol|border agent]]. The [[Government of New York (state)|New York state government]] temporarily closes all [[border crossing|border crossings]] between the United States and [[Canada]] in [[Western New York]] in response to the explosion. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/authorities-monitoring-incident-bridge-niagara-falls-ny-governor-says-2023-11-22/ (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2023 Chinese pneumonia outbreak]]
**The [[World Health Organization]] requests detailed information from [[China]] regarding a surge in [[respiratory disease]]s and [[pneumonia]] clusters among children in [[northern China]], while advising the public to adhere to preventative measures against such diseases. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/china/who-advises-chinese-to-take-measures-amid-respiratory-illness-spike/articleshow/105429350.cms (AFP via ''TOI'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Finland–Russia relations]]
**[[Prime Minister of Finland|Finnish Prime Minister]] [[Petteri Orpo]] announces that [[Finland]] will close all but the northernmost [[Finland–Russia border|border crossing]] with [[Russia]], amid an increase in [[asylum seeker]]s entering Finland via Russia. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/finland-close-all-one-border-crossing-with-russia-pm-2023-11-22/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Dutch general election]]
**Citizens of the [[Netherlands]] elect all 150 seats in the [[House of Representatives (Netherlands)|House of Representatives]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/11/22/europe/netherlands-election-intl/index.html (CNN)]
**The [[Far-right politics|far-right]] [[Party for Freedom]] led by [[Geert Wilders]] wins the most seats in [[States General of the Netherlands|parliament]], according to [[exit poll]]s. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/nov/22/far-right-party-set-to-win-most-seats-in-dutch-elections-exit-polls-show (''The Guardian'')]
